data.name: Sharwasha
data.gender_notes: Sharwasha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharwasha is a Sanskrit and Hindi name derived from the Sanskrit word 'shri', which means 'goddess of prosperity'. It is a name that signifies abundance, wealth, and good fortune. The name is also believed to bring happiness and success to the one who bears it. The name Sharwasha carries the meaning “Goddess of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharwasha usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharwasha is a name that signifies the divine presence of the goddess of prosperity. It is a name that is believed to bring blessings of wealth, abundance, and happiness to the one who bears it.
data.etymology: Sharwasha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharwasha total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
